g.text: Figure 10 - AI agent versus scanner behaviour: the two populations overlap

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42505e

g.text: Headline number: the 4 flagged scanner actors sit inside the request-rate and endpoint-breadth range of the AI agent actors - the same traffic shape that makes an agent recognisable also makes a content-discovery scanner recognisable, which is the source of the 66.67% scanner false-positive rate.
